recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 04: BabbleGuard anti-hallucination engine with RMS energy envelope analyzer, speech burst detection, isBabbleSuspect heuristic, retry resynthesis loop up to 2 times, and babblePrefer candidate comparator. Verified via BabbleGuardAntiHallucinationTest.kt.

Implemented Phase 03: Safe Emotion Tags Extraction ([cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng]) mapping to tokens 9, 10, 11 with novel bracket protection ([1], [CV]) and pre-G2P bypass. Verified via EmotionTagsAndBracketSeparationTest.kt.

Implemented Phase 02: 64-frame sliding-window circular buffer repetition penalty (RepetitionHistory) and QuickSelect Top-256 logit partitioning in VieNeuOnnxEngine. Verified via SlidingWindowRepetitionAndSamplingTest.kt.

Implemented Phase 01: Synchronized 25 preset voices from upstream, transparent alias resolution (Minh Quân Pro -> Hải Đăng), Adam bựa retention, and Thiền Tâm Đức cadence profile. Verified via VoicePresetsAndCheckpointSyncTest.kt.

decisions_made.reason: Prevents acoustic voice drift and metallic tonal decay on long sentences caused by unbounded HashSet penalty.
Reduces sorting overhead from 1024 elements to 256 before softmax, achieving ~1.5x sampling speedup per frame.
Shields novel footnote brackets [1], [CV] from being stripped while preserving <|emotion_k|> special tokens.

decisions_made.decision: BabbleGuard Energy Envelope Burst Detection & Retry Loop
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates boundary static, clicks, and trailing babble in ultra-short utterances (<=2 syllables like 'Vâng.', 'Hả?').
